Ligand 1 (jnk3 0.13) has the best SA in the pool at 1.649 and the two-link pattern I want, but QED 0.772 because of the benzoyl: 290 Da, LogP 3.47, three aromatic rings. My current leader differs from this molecule in exactly two ways - a pyridine instead of a pyrimidine, and a fluorine ortho to the arylamine - and I still cannot separate those two contributions. This episode tests the fluorine on the pyrimidine series, which gives me the halogen effect independently of the azine. Atom 14 is the aromatic CH ortho to atom 6, the carbon bearing the pyrimidinylamino, and meta to atom 3, which bears the anilide - exactly the substitution pattern my leader has. Adding a fluorine there is a one-atom change: the ring CH has an implicit hydrogen that the new bond simply displaces.
